FileSystemManager.mkdir(Object object)

Create a directory(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
dirPath String Yes Indicates the path to be determined. (Local path, which can only be in the usr directory. It can be a relative directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory. Temporary paths and cache paths are not allowed)
recursive Boolean false No Indicates whether to recursively create the upper-level directory of the directory. If the corresponding upper-level directory already exists, the upper-level directory is not created. For example, if dirPath is a/b/c/d and recursive is true, directory a is created, directory b is created in directory a, and so on until directory d is created in directory a/b/c.
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();

fs.mkdir({
  dirPath: `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/newDir`,
  success: function (res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail: function (err) {
    console.log(err);
  }
});

Tips

  1. The directory name contains a maximum of 255 characters. If the directory name is too long, API invoking fails.
  2. When creating a directory, ensure that all upper-level directories exist.
  3. If a file or directory with the same name already exists, the creation fails.
